        // The first case's hold on the erased image is released; the second case's holds stand.
        expect([...(await holds())].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { first: false, m1: false, released: false },
          { first: false, m1: true, released: false },
          { first: true, m1: false, released: false },
          { first: true, m1: true, released: true },

        // The first case's copy, taken before the removal, is erased; the second case's, taken after it, is that open case's.
        expect([...(await copies(tx, sql`target_id = ${p.postId}::uuid`))].map((s) => [s.case_id === first.caseId, s.erased])).toEqual([
          [true, true],
          [false, false],
        ]);
        // Every reader refuses the erased image; the disposal takes neither, both being held.
        const repo = createMediaRepo(tx as unknown as Db);
        expect(await repo.fileAccess(m1)).toMatchObject({ erased: true });
        expect(await repo.staffAccess(m1)).toMatchObject({ erased: true });
        expect(await repo.find(m1)).toBeNull();
        expect((await repo.forPosts([p.postId])).get(p.postId)?.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual([m2]);
        expect(await repo.readyImages(p.authorId)).toEqual([m2]);
        expect(await repo.isExportable(p.authorId, m1)).toBe(false);
        expect((await repo.dropDisposable(tx, 500)).filter((id) => p.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        // A later report joins the open second case and holds nothing more.
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
        expect(third.caseId).toBe(second.caseId);
        expect([...(await holds())].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toHaveLength(4);
        // Once the second case is closed, a report opens a new case: its copy lists the erased image without its alt
        // text, and it holds only the other image.
        await decideIn(tx, mod, second.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const fourth = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "rule");
        expect([...(await copies(tx, sql`case_id = ${fourth.caseId}::uuid`))].map((s) => s.media?.map((image) => [image.id === m1, image.alt]))).toEqual([
          [
            [true, null],
            [false, "image 2"],
          ],
        ]);
        expect([...(await tx.execute<{ m1: boolean }>(sql`select media_id = ${m1}::uuid as m1 from media_holds where case_id = ${fourth.caseId}::uuid`))].map((row) => row.m1)).toEqual([false]);
      });
    });

    test("the correction that lifts a final reset of the bio after its copies were erased: refused on the erased copy, committed on a fresh one, and its statement says that korbat does not put the old bio back", async () => {
      await inWorld3(async (tx) => {
        const account = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        await tx.execute(sql`update profiles set bio = 'my home address is 1 Example Street' where id = ${account.id}::uuid`);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, anAccount(account.id, account.handle), "rule");
        const reset = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("reset_bio")] });
        await ageCase(tx, caseId, "7 months");
        expect(await redactR4(tx, reset)).toBe(true);
        expect([...(await tx.execute<{ erased: boolean; bio: string | null }>(sql`select erased_at is not null as erased, bio from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ erased: true, bio: null }]);
        expect(await inForce(tx, { caseId })).toEqual(["reset_bio"]);

        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: reset, actions: [act("restore_bio")] }))).toBe("snapshot_erased");
        // On a fresh copy it commits, and lifts the reset.
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, salt, digest) values (${caseId}::uuid, 'account', ${account.id}::uuid, 'author', ${hex64()}, ${hex64()})`);
        const correction = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: reset, actions: [act("restore_bio")] });
        expect(await inForce(tx, { caseId })).toEqual([]);
        const found = await decisionStatement(tx as unknown as Db, correction);
        expect(found!.statement.reversals).toEqual([{ kind: "restore_bio", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: reset, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: "R4" }]);
        const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found!.statement);
        expect(paragraphs[1]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.liftedField("bio")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.field("bio")}`);
        expect(paragraphs.join(" ")).not.toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKeptR4);
        // The reset's own screen shows the content as erased under R4, and that it was reversed.
        const view = await authorDecisionView(moderationDeps(tx), account.id, reset);
        expect(view).toMatchObject({ content: { kind: "r4_redacted" }, reversedOn: expect.any(String) });
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select bio from profiles where id = ${account.id}::uuid`)).toEqual({ bio: "" });
      });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
  });
});

/**
 * The retention job, the purge's forgetting and the erasures' races (3c design, sections 6.6, 7.9, 7.10 and 12), on
 * committed rows: the job runs on the API's pool, as the server runs it, over cases that real, confirmed decisions
 * closed. The clock is moved by dating a case back as the migrator (ageCase). Everything a test committed about its
 * profiles is removed at the end; the audit rows stay, as the record does. 3e's two steps (a reply's text and the

describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the retention job", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let w: DeciderWorld;
  let mod: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;

  const profilesMade: string[] = [];
  const authRowsMade: string[] = [];

    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    w = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    before = await moderationCounts(apiDb);
    beforeAuth = await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb);
    mod = await w.staff("moderator");
    admin = await w.staff("admin");
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
      if (authRowsMade.length > 0) await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.users where id = any(${`{${authRowsMade.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    } finally {

      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }

  /** The media module's interface for cases over the API's pool, recording every batch the disposal takes and every request for files, in order. */
  function recordingMedia(onRequest?: (ids: readonly string[]) => Promise<void>): { media: MediaForCases; events: string[]; requested: string[][] } {
    const real = casesMedia(apiDb);
    const events: string[] = [];
    const requested: string[][] = [];
    const media: MediaForCases = {
      ...real,
      dropDisposable: async (tx) => {
        const ids = await real.dropDisposable(tx);
        events.push(`deleted ${ids.length}`);
        return ids;
      },
      requestDeletion: async (ids) => {
        events.push(`requested ${ids.length}`);
        requested.push([...ids]);
        await onRequest?.(ids);
      },
    };
    return { media, events, requested };
  }
  const round = (media: MediaForCases) => retentionRound({ apiDb, media, log });
  /** The retention rows of the audit log after a place, as the record holds them. */
  const retentionRows = async (after: number) =>
    [...(await apiDb.execute<{ place: number; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; step_up: unknown }>(
      sql`select chain_seq::int as place, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata, step_up from audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${after} order by chain_seq`,
    ))].map((row) => ({ ...row }));
  const head = async () => (await one<{ seq: number }>(apiDb, sql`select seq::int as seq from audit_head where id = 1`)).seq;
  /** A post with images whose author is committed and remembered for the clean-up. */
  async function post(images: number, authorId?: string) {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, images, authorId);
    if (!authorId) profilesMade.push(p.authorId);
    return p;
  }
  /** A report about the target by someone new, remembered for the clean-up. */
  async function reported(target: Parameters<typeof report>[1], by: Parameters<typeof report>[2] = "rule") {
    const made = await report(apiDb, target, by);
    const [sender] = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string | null }>(sql`select reporter_id as id from intakes where id = ${made.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
    if (sender?.id) profilesMade.push(sender.id);
    return made;
  }
  const authorDeletes = (postId: string, ago = "0 seconds") =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() - ${ago}::interval where id = ${postId}::uuid`);
  const decided = (outcome: Awaited<ReturnType<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>>): string => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  const imagesLeft = async (ids: readonly string[]) => [...(await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from post_media where id = any(${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) order by id`))].map((row) => row.id);

  test("the job runs every ten minutes under the lock job:moderation-retention, and skips a round another instance holds", async () => {
    expect(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS).toBe(10 * 60_000);
    expect(RETENTION_JOB).toBe("moderation-retention");
    const lock = new MemoryJobLock();
    const job = createRetentionJob({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), log }, lock);
    await lock.acquire("job:moderation-retention", "other", 60_000);
    expect(await job.round()).toBe("skipped");
    await lock.release("job:moderation-retention", "other");
    expect(await job.round()).toBe("ran");
    expect(await lock.acquire("job:moderation-retention", "other", 1_000)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the disposal deletes 60 image rows in three committed batches of 25, 25 and 10, each with its audit row and its files requested before the next batch", async () => {
    expect(DISPOSAL_BATCH).toBe(25);
    // Whatever earlier rounds left disposable goes first, so the batches below are this test's own.
    await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
    const owner = await newProfile(apiDb);
    profilesMade.push(owner.id);
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < 15; n++) {
      const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, owner.id);
      for (let position = 0; position < 4; position++) ids.push(await newImageRow(apiDb, owner.id, postId, position));
      await authorDeletes(postId);
    }
    const start = await head();
    /** What another session sees at each request: the batch's rows are gone and its audit row is in the record. */
    const seen: { gone: boolean; rows: number }[] = [];
    const { media, events, requested } = recordingMedia(async (batch) => {
      seen.push({ gone: (await imagesLeft(batch)).length === 0, rows: (await retentionRows(start)).length });
    });
    const report1 = await round(media);
    expect(report1.batches).toEqual([25, 25, 10]);
    expect(report1.failed).toBe(0);
    expect(events).toEqual(["deleted 25", "requested 25", "deleted 25", "requested 25", "deleted 10", "requested 10"]);
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ gone: true, rows: 1 }, { gone: true, rows: 2 }, { gone: true, rows: 3 }]);
    // The lowest ids first, each id requested once, and every one of the 60.
    expect(requested.flat()).toEqual([...ids].sort());
    expect(await imagesLeft(ids)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => [row.actor_id, row.target_type, row.target_id, row.metadata, row.step_up])).toEqual(
      [25, 25, 10].map((count) => ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", null, null, { step: "images", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count }, null]),
    );
    // A second round changes nothing and writes no audit row.
    const again = recordingMedia();
    expect(await round(again.media)).toEqual({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, redactions: 0, statements: 0, replies: 0, reportCounts: 0, accessLog: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(again.requested).toEqual([]);
    expect(await head()).toBe(start + 3);
  });

  test("every row of the retention table through one round with the clock moved: evidence, the intake record, an R4 redaction of a deleted post of a purged account, statements, drafts, the access log and the kept images; the late counts before, and none after", async () => {
    let now = Date.now();
    let contactsLate = 0;
    const auth: AuthForModeration = { ...noAuthForModeration(), overdueContacts: async () => contactsLate } as AuthForModeration;
    const late = () => erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth, now: () => new Date(now) });
    const baseline = await late();

    // A notice of illegality answered without action 13 months ago, released and mailed then; a note, a draft, an access row.
    const q = await post(1);

    decided(await w.decideAs(mod, quiet.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
    await saveText(apiDb, quiet.caseId, mod.id, "note", "a note on the case");
    const draft = await saveText(apiDb, quiet.caseId, mod.id, "facts", "a draft nobody confirmed");
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into case_access_log (staff_id, case_id, kind) values (${mod.id}::uuid, ${quiet.caseId}::uuid, 'case_opened')`);
    await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, quiet.recorded.intakeId);
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, quiet.caseId, "13 months 3 days");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = received_at - interval '13 months 3 days' where id = ${quiet.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`);
    // An R4 removal that became final a month ago; its author deleted the post, and the account was purged 13 months ago.
    const p = await post(2);
    const r4 = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
    const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, r4.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
    await authorDeletes(p.postId, "3 days");
    await ageCase(w.migrateDb, r4.caseId, "7 months");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months 2 days' where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
    await authAccount(w.migrateDb, p.authorId, "13 months 2 days");
    authRowsMade.push(p.authorId);
    // An image of a post deleted three days ago that no case ever held: the disposal is late with it.
    const junk = await post(1);
    await authorDeletes(junk.postId, "3 days");
    contactsLate = 4;

    now += ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS + 1;
    const lateBefore = await late();
    const more = (key: keyof typeof baseline) => lateBefore[key] - baseline[key];
    expect({ caseEvidence: more("caseEvidence"), intakeRecords: more("intakeRecords"), statements: more("statements"), redactions: more("redactions"), images: more("images"), drafts: more("drafts"), accessLog: more("accessLog"), contacts: lateBefore.contacts }).toEqual({
      caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 1, statements: 1, redactions: 1, images: 1, drafts: 1, accessLog: 1, contacts: 4,
    });
    // Within the minute every reader is answered what was read last, whatever changed since; a minute later it is read again.
    contactsLate = 0;
    expect(await late()).toBe(lateBefore);

    const start = await head();
    const { media, requested } = recordingMedia();
    const done = await round(media);
    expect(done).toMatchObject({ cases: 2, intakes: 1, redactions: 1, statements: 1, batches: [3], failed: 0 });
    expect(done.drafts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(done.accessLog).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    // The no-action case: snapshot, note and hold gone; its image stays, since its post does.
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, quiet.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(q.mediaIds)).toEqual(q.mediaIds);
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where digest = ${draft}`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from case_access_log where case_id = ${quiet.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    // The intake record: its words and its sender gone, its items kept.
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select explanation, reporter_id, erased_at is not null as erased, (select count(*)::int from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id and i.outcome = 'no_violation') as items from intakes n where id = ${quiet.recorded.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ explanation: null, reporter_id: null, erased: true, items: 1 });
    // The R4 removal: the post erased for good under its author's deletion, every copy gone, the statement's texts erased, the images deleted and their files requested.
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select body, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ body: "", state: "deleted_by_author", level: "removed", erased: true });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r4.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${r4.caseId}::uuid and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft([...p.mediaIds, ...junk.mediaIds])).toEqual([]);
    expect(requested.flat().sort()).toEqual([...p.mediaIds, ...junk.mediaIds].sort());

    // Each step's audit row: the server's own, ids and counts only.
    const rows = await retentionRows(start);
    expect(rows.every((row) => row.actor_id === "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" && row.target_type === null && row.target_id === null && row.step_up === null)).toBe(true);
    for (const row of rows) expect(Object.keys(row.metadata).sort()).toEqual(["caseId", "count", "decisionId", "intakeId", "step"]);
    const named = (step: string, key: string, id: string) => rows.filter((row) => row.metadata.step === step && row.metadata[key] === id).map((row) => row.metadata);
    expect(named("case_evidence", "caseId", quiet.caseId)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: quiet.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    expect(named("case_evidence", "caseId", r4.caseId)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: r4.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    expect(named("intake_record", "intakeId", quiet.recorded.intakeId)).toEqual([{ step: "intake_record", caseId: null, intakeId: quiet.recorded.intakeId, decisionId: null, count: 2 }]);
    expect(named("redaction", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "redaction", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 1 }]);
    expect(named("statements", "decisionId", removal)).toEqual([{ step: "statements", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: removal, count: 2 }]);
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.metadata.step)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["drafts", "access_log", "images"]));
    // In the order of the steps: the drafts first, the images last.
    expect(rows[0]!.metadata.step).toBe("drafts");
    expect(rows.at(-1)!.metadata).toEqual({ step: "images", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 });

    // Nothing is late any more, and a second round changes nothing and writes nothing.
    now += ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS + 1;
    expect(await late()).toEqual({ ...baseline, contacts: 0 });
    const after = await head();
    expect(await round(casesMedia(apiDb))).toEqual({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, redactions: 0, statements: 0, replies: 0, reportCounts: 0, accessLog: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await head()).toBe(after);
  });

  test.each(["its author's account", "its author's purged account", "the post itself, by the item korbat adds for a quoted post"] as const)(
    "a closed case holding the images of a post its author then deleted, due while the post is frozen through %s: every step of a round leaves its snapshot and its image rows, its notes go and its holds are released, and no file is requested; after an answer without a seal the next round takes them",
    async (reach) => {

    let suspectCases: string[];
    if (reach.startsWith("the post")) {

    } else {

      suspectCases = [(await reported(anAccount(f.authorId), "csam")).caseId];
    }

    const first = recordingMedia();

    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 1, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);
    expect((await retentionRows(start)).map((row) => row.metadata)).toEqual([{ step: "case_evidence", caseId: closed.caseId, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: 3 }]);
    // The case holds only a snapshot of a frozen post now: it is no candidate, nothing is late, and a round leaves it alone.
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 10 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });
    expect({ caseEvidence: counts.caseEvidence, images: counts.images }).toEqual({ caseEvidence: 0, images: 0 });
    expect(await round(first.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 0, batches: [0], failed: 0 });
    expect(first.requested).toEqual([]);

    // An admin answers the report without a seal: the freeze ends. Two days on, the answered cases' own evidence is due
    // too (the case of the post itself held the images for that long), and one round takes everything.
    for (const id of suspectCases) {
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, id, "2 days");
    }
    const second = recordingMedia();
    expect(await round(second.media)).toMatchObject({ cases: 1 + suspectCases.length, batches: [2], failed: 0 });
    expect(await evidenceLeft(apiDb, closed.caseId)).toEqual({ snapshots: 0, texts: 0, statements: 0, holds: 0 });
    expect(await imagesLeft(f.mediaIds)).toEqual([]);
    expect(second.requested.flat().sort()).toEqual([...f.mediaIds].sort());
    },
  );

  test("a row that raises is rolled back alone with no audit row, is logged with its step and its id, and never stops another row; the count of what is late names it", async () => {
    // A decision whose subject's profile says deleted 13 months ago while its auth row is live: the job names it, the database refuses it.

    expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from staff_texts where case_id = ${made.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null and text is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
    const counts = await erasureOverdue({ apiDb, media: casesMedia(apiDb), auth: noAuthForModeration(), now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 20 * ERASURE_OVERDUE_TTL_MS) });

    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = null where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
  });

  describe("MODERATION_RETENTION", () => {
    /** A lock that says which keys were asked for, and resolves when one is let go. */
    function watchedLock() {
      const inner = new MemoryJobLock();
      const asked: string[] = [];
      const released = new Map<string, () => void>();
      const lock: JobLock = {
        acquire: (key, token, ttlMs) => {
          asked.push(key);
          return inner.acquire(key, token, ttlMs);
        },
        refresh: (key, token, ttlMs) => inner.refresh(key, token, ttlMs),
        release: async (key, token) => {
          await inner.release(key, token);
          released.get(key)?.();
        },
      };
      const until = (key: string) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => released.set(key, resolve));
      return { lock, asked, until };
    }

    test.each(["off", "on"] as const)("%s: after ten minutes the dispatch job's round runs, and the retention job's only while the switch is on; off, the warning is logged and a due case keeps its snapshot and a due R4 decision's post its body", async (setting) => {
      const p = await post(0);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      const state = async () => ({
        ...(await one<{ body: string; redacted: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select (select body from posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid) as body, (select redacted_at is not null from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid) as redacted`)),
        snapshots: (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, made.caseId)).snapshots,
      });
      expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 });

      const warnings: string[] = [];
      const logger = pino({ level: "warn" }, { write: (line: string) => void warnings.push((JSON.parse(line) as { msg: string }).msg) });
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: { ...loadConfig(), MODERATION_RETENTION: setting }, logger });
      const { lock, asked, until } = watchedLock();
      vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setTimeout", "clearTimeout"] });
      let stop: () => void = () => undefined;
      try {
        stop = moderation.startJobs(lock);
        expect(warnings.filter((line) => line === RETENTION_OFF_WARNING)).toHaveLength(setting === "off" ? 1 : 0);
        expect(RETENTION_OFF_WARNING).toBe("moderation-retention: off (MODERATION_RETENTION)");
        const dispatched = until("job:moderation-dispatch");
        const retained = setting === "on" ? until("job:moderation-retention") : Promise.resolve();
        // Nothing runs before the ten minutes are over.
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(RETENTION_INTERVAL_MS - 1);
        expect(asked).toEqual([]);
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(2);
        await Promise.all([dispatched, retained]);
      } finally {
        stop();
        vi.useRealTimers();
      }
      expect(asked).toContain("job:moderation-dispatch");
      expect(asked.includes("job:moderation-retention")).toBe(setting === "on");
      expect(await state()).toEqual(setting === "off" ? { body: "a post", redacted: false, snapshots: 1 } : { body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      // The author's decision screen: the copy while korbat holds it, and after the job's redaction the words of an R4 erasure.
      expect((await authorDecisionView({ apiDb }, p.authorId, removal)).content.kind).toBe(setting === "off" ? "post" : "r4_redacted");
      // What the switch held back is made up by a round once it is on again.
      if (setting === "off") {
        await round(casesMedia(apiDb));
        expect(await state()).toEqual({ body: "", redacted: true, snapshots: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  describe("the purge's forgetting", () => {
    test("forgetAccount forgets the reports of an account the take-down marked deleted, changes nothing for a live one, and nothing when run again", async () => {
      const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: noAuthForModeration(), social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), config: loadConfig(), logger: log });
      const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(w.authDb));
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${`r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`}, 'Reporter')`);
      profilesMade.push(user.id);
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await recordIntake(moderation.deps, { ground: ground.rule(user.id), live: [aPost(p.postId)] });
      const linked = () => one(apiDb, sql`select (select reporter_id from intakes where id = ${recorded.intakeId}::uuid) as intake, (select reporter_account_id from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid) as item`);

      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: user.id, item: user.id });
      // The take-down's mark, as the auth role sets it; from then on the purge's step forgets the links.
      await w.authDb.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() where id = ${user.id}::uuid and deleted_at is null`);
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      await moderation.forAccount.forgetAccount(user.id);
      expect(await linked()).toEqual({ intake: null, item: null });
      // The report goes on: its item still waits in its case.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where id = ${recorded.items[0]!.id}::uuid and outcome is null and case_id is not null`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  describe("the erasures' races", () => {
    /** A signed-out notice of illegality about a new post, answered without action and released `ago` ago: no account stands on its items. */
    async function releasedNotice(ago: string) {
      const p = await post(0);
      const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(null), aPost(p.postId));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      decided(await w.decideAs(mod, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }));
      await releaseItems(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId);
      await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, recorded.intakeId, ago);
      return { ...p, caseId, intakeId: recorded.intakeId, itemId: recorded.items[0]!.id };
    }
    /** The re-examination's item, as the intake transaction inserts it, in a new open case of the post. */
    const reexamine = (db: Parameters<typeof insertItem>[0], n: { intakeId: string; postId: string; itemId: string }, caseId: string, marker?: string) =>
      insertItem(db, { intakeId: n.intakeId, caseId, targetId: n.postId, lane: 1, reexaminesItemId: n.itemId, marker });
    const openCaseOf = async (postId: string) => (await one<{ id: string }>(apiDb, sql`insert into cases (target_type, target_id) values ('post', ${postId}::uuid) returning id`)).id;

    test("a re-examination that holds the intake first makes the erasure wait, and the erasure then finds the intake not due", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("5 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let erasing: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The re-examination is inside its window, and its transaction holds the intake's row.
        await reexamine(tx, n, caseId);
        // Meanwhile the window runs out: without the new item the intake's record would be due.
        await ageIntake(w.migrateDb, n.intakeId, "8 months");
        erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid)`));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await erasing).toBe("not_due");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is null as held, explanation is not null as words from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ held: true, words: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("an erasure that holds the intake first makes the re-examination wait, and the re-examination is then refused: nothing is asked of an erased record", async () => {
      const n = await releasedNotice("8 months");
      const caseId = await openCaseOf(n.postId);
      const marker = newMarker();
      let asking: Promise<string | null> = Promise.resolve(null);
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.erase_intake(${n.intakeId}::uuid) as n`)).toMatchObject({ n: expect.any(Number) });
        // The item's release is dated forward again while the erasure is still open: by the clock alone the window
        // would be open, so only the erased record refuses the request.
        await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now() - interval '5 months' where id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`);
        asking = refusal(reexamine(apiDb, n, caseId, marker));
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      });
      expect(await asking).toBe("reexamination_not_open");
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select erased_at is not null as erased from intakes where id = ${n.intakeId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ erased: true });
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from intake_items where reexamines_item_id = ${n.itemId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 0 });
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from cases where id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
    });

    /** A post removed under R1 seven months ago: its restriction is final for its author, and its case's evidence is due. */
    async function dueRemoval() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const made = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, made.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, made.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, caseId: made.caseId, removal };
    }
    const snapshotErased = async (caseId: string) => (await evidenceLeft(apiDb, caseId)).snapshots === 0;

    test("a correction that names the old snapshot and takes the case first commits before the erasure, which then erases the snapshot", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const release = gate();
      const held = gate();
      // Another session holds the post's row, which the correction's measure needs after it has taken the case.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from posts where id = ${r.postId}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into decision_actions (decision_id");
      const erasing = refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`));
      await untilBlocked(apiDb, marker);
      release.open();
      await holding;
      const correction = decided(await correcting);
      expect(await erasing).toBeNull();
      // The correction committed naming a snapshot that was whole at its commit; the erasure came after it.
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select (select decided_at from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid) <= (select erased_at from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid) as before`)).toEqual({ before: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
    });

    test("an erasure that takes the case first erases the snapshot, and the correction that named it is refused: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`);
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the case, and that already waits for the erasure, which holds the case's row.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into staff_texts (case_id");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.caseId)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });

    test("a correction that names a snapshot taken in the last day commits, and the erasure is refused: the case is not due for a day", async () => {
      const r = await dueRemoval();
      const fresh = await one<{ id: string; digest: string }>(w.migrateDb, sql`
        insert into evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
        select case_id, target_type, target_id, author_handle, body, salt, digest from evidence_snapshots where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid returning id, digest`);
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      decided(await w.decideAs(admin, r.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.removal, actions: [act("restore")], snapshotId: fresh.id, snapshotDigest: fresh.digest }));
      expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${r.caseId}::uuid)`))).toBe("not_due");
      expect((await evidenceLeft(apiDb, r.caseId)).snapshots).toBe(2);
    });

    /**
     * A post with one image and two closed cases. The earlier one removed the image under R1 eight months ago, and its copy
     * of the post was taken then. The later one removed the post under R4 seven months ago: that removal is final for its
     * author, so its redaction is due, and the earlier case's copy, taken before it, holds what it restricted.
     */
    async function dueRedaction() {
      const p = await post(1);
      const earlier = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const imageRemoval = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, earlier.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove_media", p.mediaIds[0]!)] }));
      const later = await reported(aPost(p.postId));
      const removal = decided(await w.decideAs(mod, later.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] }));
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, earlier.caseId, "8 months");
      await ageCase(w.migrateDb, later.caseId, "7 months");
      return { ...p, earlier: earlier.caseId, imageRemoval, later: later.caseId, removal };
    }

    test("the R4 redaction takes every case whose copy it erases before it erases one: it waits for a transaction that holds an earlier case of the post, as a decision on that case does, and erases that case's copy only afterwards", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      const marker = newMarker();
      const [held, release] = [gate(), gate()];
      // A decision takes its case's row in this mode before it reads the copy it names.
      const holding = withLockTimeout(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from cases where id = ${r.earlier}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await release.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const redacting = one<{ changed: boolean }>(apiDb, sql`select /* ${sql.raw(marker)} */ public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`);
      try {
        // The redaction either comes to wait, or ends without waiting: then it erased the earlier case's copy beside
        // whoever holds that case, and a decision in that place would commit naming a copy erased under it.
        const first = await Promise.race([
          untilBlocked(apiDb, marker).then(() => "waited" as const, () => "never waited" as const),
          redacting.then(() => "ended without waiting" as const, () => "ended without waiting" as const),
        ]);
        expect(first).toBe("waited");
        expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(false);
      } finally {
        release.open();
        await holding;
      }
      expect(await redacting).toEqual({ changed: true });
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.later)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select redacted_at is not null as redacted from decisions where id = ${r.removal}::uuid`)).toEqual({ redacted: true });
    });

    test("a correction of an earlier case's decision that names a copy the R4 redaction is erasing waits for the redaction at that case and is refused before it commits: snapshot_erased", async () => {
      const r = await dueRedaction();
      let correcting: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${r.removal}::uuid) as changed`)).toEqual({ changed: true });
        correcting = w.decideAs(admin, r.earlier, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: r.imageRemoval, actions: [act("restore_media", r.mediaIds[0]!)] });
        // The correction first saves its reason on the earlier case, and that already waits for the redaction, which holds
        // that case's row because it erases that case's copy. A redaction that held only its own case would let the
        // correction read the copy whole and commit naming it.
        await untilBlocked(apiDb, "insert into");
      });
      expect(await refusal(correcting)).toBe("snapshot_erased");
      expect(await snapshotErased(r.earlier)).toBe(true);
      expect(await one(apiDb, sql`select count(*)::int as n from decisions where case_id = ${r.earlier}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what its tests committed is removed, and the moderation tables and the four auth tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, profilesMade);
    profilesMade.length = 0;
    // The two staff members' own rows go with the world; their decisions are gone with the cases above.
    expect(await moderationCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)).toEqual(beforeAuth);
  });
});

      });

    test("posts and profiles are never deleted, and the moderation columns of posts and images are never written", async () => {
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const ada = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, ada.id);
        const mediaId = await newImageRow(tx, ada.id, postId);
        const refused: [ReturnType<typeof sql>, RegExp][] = [
          [sql`delete from posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table posts/],
          [sql`delete from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`, /permission denied for table profiles/],
          [sql`truncate posts cascade`, /permission denied for table/],
          [sql`truncate profiles cascade`, /permission denied for table/],
          [sql`truncate post_media cascade`, /permission denied for table/],
          [sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${postId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table posts/],
          [sql`update posts set erased_at = now() where id = ${postId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table posts/],
          [sql`update posts set author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid where id = ${postId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table posts/],
          [sql`update post_media set moderation_state = 'sealed' where id = ${mediaId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table post_media/],
          [sql`update post_media set hold_until = null where id = ${mediaId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table post_media/],
          [sql`update post_media set erased_at = now() where id = ${mediaId}::uuid`, /permission denied for table post_media/],
        ];
        for (const [statement, refusal] of refused) expect((await run(tx, statement))?.message, JSON.stringify(statement.queryChunks[0])).toMatch(refusal);
        // What the API writes today still works: a counter, the author's deletion and an upload's verdict.
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update posts set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = ${postId}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${postId}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        const upload = await newImageRow(tx, ada.id, null);
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update post_media set status = 'failed', error = 'processing_failed' where id = ${upload}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("it can neither switch off nor replace a trigger of the moderation tables", async () => {
      const refusals: [ReturnType<typeof sql>, RegExp][] = [
        [sql`alter table public.post_media disable trigger post_media_keep`, /must be owner of table post_media/],
        [sql`alter table public.intake_items disable trigger all`, /must be owner of table intake_items/],
        [sql`drop trigger post_media_guard on public.post_media`, /must be owner of (table|relation) post_media/],
        [sql`create or replace function public.frozen_for(post uuid, author uuid) returns boolean language sql as 'select false'`, /permission denied|must be owner/],
        [sql`drop trigger intake_items_quote on public.intake_items`, /must be owner of (table|relation) intake_items/],
      ];
      for (const [statement, refusal] of refusals) expect((await asApi(statement))?.message, JSON.stringify(statement.queryChunks[0])).toMatch(refusal);
    });
  });

  describe("what the auth role holds on the new auth tables", () => {
    test("a contact is stored, read and deleted, and only its forget_after is ever updated", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_contacts")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_contacts")).toEqual(["forget_after"]);
      await rolledBack(authDb, async (tx) => {
        const id = randomUUID();
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into auth.notifier_contacts (id, name_enc, email_enc, email_hash, forget_after) values (${id}::uuid, 'v1:n', 'v1:e', ${hex64()}, now() + interval '13 months')`);
        expect(await run(tx, sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set forget_after = now() + interval '6 months' where id = ${id}::uuid`)).toBeNull();
        // Never re-encrypted, renamed or pointed at another address.
        for (const column of ["name_enc", "email_enc", "email_hash", "mail_token_enc", "created_at"]) {
          const err = await run(tx, sql`update auth.notifier_contacts set ${sql.identifier(column)} = null where id = ${id}::uuid`);
          expect(err?.message, column).toMatch(/permission denied for table notifier_contacts/);
        }
        const gone = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`delete from auth.notifier_contacts where id = ${id}::uuid returning id`);
        expect(gone).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    });

    test("confirmations keep every default privilege; a suppression is inserted, read and deleted, never changed", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_confirmations")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_suppressions")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT", "DELETE"]);
      expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_auth", "auth.notifier_suppressions")).toEqual([]);
    });

    test("it holds nothing on the staff links, which only the migrator writes and reads", async () => {
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth.staff_personal_accounts")).toEqual([]);
      expect((await asAuth(sql`select count(*) from auth.staff_personal_accounts`))?.message).toMatch(/permission denied for table staff_personal_accounts/);
      expect((await asAuth(sql`insert into auth.staff_personal_accounts (staff_user_id, personal_user_id) values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${randomUUID()}::uuid)`))?.message).toMatch(
        /permission denied for table staff_personal_accounts/,
      );
    });
  });

  describe("the functions and who names them", () => {
    type Fn = { name: string; args: string; owner: string; definer: boolean; config: string[] | null; api: boolean; auth: boolean; pub: boolean; definition: string };
    /** Every function of the public and auth schemas with its definition, as the catalogue holds it. */
    const functions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<Fn>(sql`
        select p.pronamespace::regnamespace::text || '.' || p.proname as name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as args, p.proowner::regrole::text as owner,
               p.prosecdef as definer, p.proconfig as config, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', p.oid, 'execute') as api,
               has_function_privilege('korbat_auth', p.oid, 'execute') as auth, has_function_privilege('public', p.oid, 'execute') as pub,
               pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition
          from pg_proc p
         where p.pronamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace) and p.prokind = 'f'
         order by 1`);

    /** Every other definition the database holds that could name a function: views, triggers, constraints, index predicates and policies. */
    const otherDefinitions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<{ kind: string; name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select 'view' as kind, c.relname::text as name, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition from pg_class c where c.relkind = 'v' and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'trigger', t.tgname::text, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid where not t.tgisinternal and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'constraint', n.conname::text, pg_get_constraintdef(n.oid) from pg_constraint n where n.connamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'index', i.indexrelid::regclass::text, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid = i.indrelid where c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'policy', p.polname::text, coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid), '') || ' ' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid), '') from pg_policy p`);

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0015, each with its search path pinned and EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The few a role calls directly are granted to that role alone; a trigger
      // function fires for every role all the same, and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_deadline: [false, true],
        case_access_log_insert: [false, false],
        cases_insert: [false, false],
        evidence_snapshots_insert: [false, false],
        frozen_for: [false, true],
        intake_items_attach: [true, false],
        intake_items_quote: [true, false],
        intakes_insert: [false, false],
        media_holds_apply: [true, false],
        media_holds_insert: [false, false],
        post_frozen: [false, true],
        post_media_guard: [false, false],
        post_media_insert: [false, false],
        post_media_keep: [true, false],
        staff_texts_insert: [false, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
    });

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0016; the API role may call four of them and no other", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role, the pinned search path]. The trigger functions fire for every role and nobody
      // calls them; moderation_apply, the one writer of the moderation columns, is called only by its owner's functions.

        decision_actions_recheck: [true, false, pub],

      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api, config] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // Every function of the public schema is one of 0015's or 0016's lists, or older than both.
      const callable = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && f.api).map((f) => f.name.slice(7));
      expect(callable).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["append_confirmed_audit", "release_outcomes", "snapshot_withheld", "staff_case_conflict"]));
      for (const name of ["moderation_apply", "item_current_outcome", "account_is_staff", "staff_party_conflict"]) expect(callable, name).not.toContain(name);
    });

    test("the migrator owns the three functions of 0017; the API role may call the two that answer who reviews, and the three it replaced keep their owner and grants", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The appeal's trigger function fires for every role and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_reviewer_state: [true, true],
        appeals_check: [true, false],
        review_needs_admin: [true, true],
        // Replaced by 0017 with CREATE OR REPLACE, which keeps what 0016 gave them.

        decisions_apply: [true, false],
        decisions_record: [true, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
      // The replaced functions are the new ones: a review is accepted, an appeal is answered, and a seal is asked of the view.
      const definition = (name: string) => rows.find((f) => f.name === `public.${name}`)!.definition;
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).toMatch(/reviewer_conflict/);
      expect(definition("decisions_record")).not.toMatch(/waits for the migration/);
      expect(definition("decisions_apply")).toMatch(/UPDATE public\.appeals/);
      expect(definition("decision_actions_apply")).toMatch(/measures_in_force m WHERE m\.id = NEW\.id/);
      // review_needs_admin reads the decision and its ledger, never the freeze.
      expect(definition("review_needs_admin")).not.toMatch(/frozen|intake_items|cases/);
    });

    test("the appeal's trigger is on its table, before the insert", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid = 'public.appeals'::regclass order by 1`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.definition.replace(/^CREATE (CONSTRAINT )?TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, "")])).toEqual([["appeals_check", "BEFORE INSERT ON public.appeals FOR EACH ROW"]]);
    });

      for (const f of rows) {

        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });

      expect(authSide.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }))).toEqual([
        { name: "auth.staff_link_counts", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: true, config: auth, api: false, auth: true, pub: false },
        { name: "auth.users_deleted_mark", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: false, config: auth, api: false, auth: false, pub: false },

      // Everything the API role may call of what the migrator owns, in both schemas, after the last migration of 3c (design,

      // and 3e's two steps of the retention job (0024_standing_retention): a reply's text and the reporting counts.
      const callable = all.filter((f) => f.owner === "korbat_migrate" && f.api).map((f) => f.name);
      expect(callable).toEqual([
        "public.appeal_deadline",
        "public.appeal_informed_at",
        "public.appeal_reviewer_state",
        "public.append_confirmed_audit",
        "public.case_evidence_due_at",

    test("the deletion mark's trigger is on auth.users, before an update that names the mark", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ definition: string }>(sql`
        select pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid
         where not t.tgisinternal and c.relnamespace = 'auth'::regnamespace and c.relname = 'users' and t.tgname = 'users_deleted_mark'`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.definition.replace(/^CREATE TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, ""))).toEqual(["BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW"]);
    });

    test("every function the migrator owns in the two schemas pins its search path and is closed to PUBLIC", async () => {
      const owned = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.owner === "korbat_migrate");
      expect(owned.length).toBeGreaterThan(15);
      for (const f of owned) {
        expect(f.config?.some((setting) => /^search_path=(public|auth), pg_temp$/.test(setting)), f.name).toBe(true);
        expect(f.pub, f.name).toBe(false);
      }
    });

    test("frozen_for is named only by post_frozen and by the keep trigger's function; post_frozen only by decisions_record, erase_snapshots and redact_r4_body", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const naming = (word: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => word.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // Each function's own definition holds its name.
      expect(naming(/\bfrozen_for\b/)).toEqual(["public.frozen_for", "public.post_frozen", "public.post_media_keep"]);
      // One function of 0016 reads the freeze: the one that stores whether a decision was taken while nobody could open the images.
      // And two of 0018: the one function that erases a snapshot (gate E), and the R4 redaction, which waits while its post is frozen.
      expect(naming(/\bpost_frozen\b/)).toEqual(["public.decisions_record", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.post_frozen", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Nor does a view, a trigger, a constraint, an index or a policy name either.
      const others = (await otherDefinitions()).filter((d) => /\b(frozen_for|post_frozen)\b/.test(d.definition));
      expect(others.map((d) => `${d.kind} ${d.name}`)).toEqual([]);
    });

    test("one function writes a seal's list, and one the moderation columns of posts and images", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const matching = (statement: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => statement.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // A statement that writes the table, as SQL may spell it: an insert, an update, a delete or a merge, the name bare or
      // schema-qualified, quoted or not; for a column, an update, a merge or an insert that updates on a conflict.
      const sealList = /(insert\s+into|update|delete\s+from|merge\s+into)\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?seal_posts"?(?![\w"])/i;
      const imageState = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?moderation_state"?\s*=/i;
      const postColumns = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?posts"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(moderation_level|state|erased_at)"?\s*=/i;
      const calls = /\bmoderation_apply\s*\(/i;
      expect(matching(sealList)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply"]);
      expect(matching(imageState)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      // Of the three columns of posts, the level and the state are moderation_apply's alone; the erasure mark is the R4 redaction's.
      expect(matching(postColumns)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      const written = (table: string, columns: string) =>
        new RegExp(String.raw`(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?${table}"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(${columns})"?\s*=`, "i");
      const postLevel = written("posts", "moderation_level|state");
      const postErased = written("posts", "erased_at");
      const imageErased = written("post_media", "erased_at");
      const snapshotErased = written("evidence_snapshots", "erased_at");
      expect(matching(postLevel)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      expect(matching(postErased)).toEqual(["public.redact_r4_body"]);
      expect(matching(imageErased)).toEqual(["public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Gate E: one function writes a snapshot's erasure, no function deletes a snapshot, and that one function is called
      // by the two erasures of 0018 and by nothing else.
      expect(matching(snapshotErased)).toEqual(["public.erase_snapshots"]);
      expect(matching(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?evidence_snapshots"?(?![\w"])/i)).toEqual([]);
      expect(matching(/\berase_snapshots\s*\(/i)).toEqual(["public.erase_case_evidence", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // The writer is called by the two triggers that follow a stored decision and a stored measure, and by the R4 redaction.
      expect(matching(calls)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply", "public.decisions_apply", "public.moderation_apply", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.evidence_snapshots s SET erased_at = now(), body = NULL",
        'update only "public"."evidence_snapshots" set "erased_at" = $1',
        "merge into evidence_snapshots s using v on s.id = v.id when matched then update set erased_at = now()",
      ]) {
        expect(snapshotErased.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(snapshotErased.test("select 1 from public.evidence_snapshots s where s.erased_at is null; update public.staff_texts t set erased_at = now()")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = coalesce(m.erased_at, now())")).toBe(true);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.media_holds h SET released_at = now(); select m.erased_at = now() from public.post_media m")).toBe(false);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET body = '', erased_at = now()")).toBe(true);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET moderation_level = v.level WHERE p.erased_at IS NOT NULL")).toBe(false);
      // Each search finds such a statement in every form, and no other statement.
      for (const statement of [
        "INSERT INTO public.seal_posts (action_id, post_id, images)",
        'insert into "public"."seal_posts" (action_id)',
        "update seal_posts s set images = 1",
        'DELETE FROM ONLY "seal_posts" s',
        "merge into public.seal_posts s using listed l on l.post_id = s.post_id",
      ]) {
        expect(sealList.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(sealList.test("select 1 from public.seal_posts s; delete from public.seal_posts_kept")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.post_media i SET status = 'ready', moderation_state = v.state",
        'update only "public"."post_media" set "moderation_state" = $1',
        "insert into post_media (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set moderation_state = excluded.moderation_state",
        "merge into public.post_media m using v on m.id = v.id when matched then update set moderation_state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(imageState.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(imageState.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET hold_until = latest WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id; SELECT moderation_state = 'x'")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageState.test("insert into public.post_media (owner_id, moderation_state) values ($1, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "update posts set body = '', state = 'removed'",
        'UPDATE "public"."posts" p SET "moderation_level" = v.level',
        "insert into public.posts (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set erased_at = now()",
        "merge into posts p using v on p.id = v.id when matched then update set state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(postColumns.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(postColumns.test("insert into public.posts (author_id, body, state) values ($1, $2, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      expect(postColumns.test("update public.posts_archive set state = 'removed'")).toBe(false);
    });

    test("no function deletes from post_media: the image rows go only by a statement the keep trigger meets", async () => {
      const deleting = (await functions()).filter((f) => /delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test(f.definition));
      expect(deleting.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual([]);
      // The search finds such a statement where there is one.
      expect(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test('DELETE FROM "public"."post_media" WHERE id = $1')).toBe(true);
      expect(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?\b/i.test("delete from public.post_media m where m.id = x")).toBe(true);
    });

    test("the triggers of 0015 are on their tables, in the timing the design gives", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t
         where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid in ('public.cases'::regclass, 'public.intakes'::regclass, 'public.intake_items'::regclass, 'public.staff_texts'::regclass,
               'public.evidence_snapshots'::regclass, 'public.case_access_log'::regclass, 'public.post_media'::regclass, 'public.media_holds'::regclass)
         order by 1`);
      const timing = Object.fromEntries(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.definition.replace(/^CREATE (CONSTRAINT )?TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, "")]));
      expect(timing).toEqual({
        case_access_log_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.case_access_log FOR EACH ROW",
        cases_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.cases FOR EACH ROW",
        evidence_snapshots_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.evidence_snapshots FOR EACH ROW",
        intake_items_attach: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.intake_items FOR EACH ROW",
        intake_items_quote: "AFTER INSERT ON public.intake_items DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW",
        intakes_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.intakes FOR EACH ROW",
        media_holds_apply: "AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.media_holds FOR EACH ROW",
        media_holds_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.media_holds FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_guard: 'BEFORE UPDATE OF post_id, owner_id, alt_text, "position", width, height, blurhash ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW',
        post_media_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_keep: "BEFORE DELETE ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3e's reporting counts (0022_reporting_counts) add the tally of each report after it is stored, on the same table.
        report_tallies_count: "AFTER INSERT ON public.intakes FOR EACH ROW",
        staff_texts_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.staff_texts FOR EACH ROW",
      });
    });

    test("the triggers of 0016 are on their tables, in the timing the design gives", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t
         where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid in ('public.posts'::regclass, 'public.decisions'::regclass, 'public.decision_actions'::regclass)
         order by 1`);
      const timing = Object.fromEntries(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.definition.replace(/^CREATE (CONSTRAINT )?TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, "")]));
      expect(timing).toEqual({
        decision_actions_apply: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decision_actions FOR EACH ROW",
        decision_actions_check: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.decision_actions FOR EACH ROW",
        // The decision's check at commit, queued again by every row of its ledger.
        decision_actions_recheck: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decision_actions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_apply: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_check: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decisions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3e: a statement mail's outcome moves one way, and fixes the start of an announced measure.
        decisions_mail_forward: "BEFORE UPDATE OF author_mail, author_mail_at ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_mail_standing: expect.stringMatching(/^AFTER UPDATE OF author_mail ON public[.]decisions FOR EACH ROW WHEN /),
        decisions_record: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        posts_guard_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW",
        // Only a statement that names one of the three columns and changes one meets the guard: a counter's update never does.
        posts_guard_update: expect.stringMatching(/^BEFORE UPDATE OF state, moderation_level, erased_at ON public\.posts FOR EACH ROW WHEN \(.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*\)$/),
      });
    });

    test("the case's history runs with its reader's rights, and the API role only reads it", async () => {
      const [view] = await apiDb.execute<{ options: string[] | null }>(sql`select c.reloptions as options from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.case_history'::regclass`);
      expect(view!.options).toEqual(["security_invoker=true"]);
      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_api", "public.case_history")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
      const columns = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string }>(sql`select attname::text as name from pg_attribute where attrelid = 'public.case_history'::regclass and attnum > 0 order by attnum`);
      expect(columns.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["case_id", "at", "event", "ref_id", "seq", "intake_kind", "rule_id", "alleges_illegal", "csam", "reexamination", "decision_kind", "outcome", "staff_id", "result"]);
    });

    test("measures_in_force runs with its reader's rights and names exactly the contracts' measures", async () => {
      const [view] = await apiDb.execute<{ options: string[] | null; definition: string }>(sql`select c.reloptions as options, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.measures_in_force'::regclass`);
      expect(view!.options).toEqual(["security_invoker=true"]);
      const measures = ACTION_KINDS.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
      // 3e: the view names its kinds as text (enum-literals.test.ts: a value 3e added cannot be an enum literal in the
      // migration that adds it), and the seal's own literal as the enum; both forms are read.
      const named = [...view!.definition.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)'::(?:action_kind|text)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
      expect([...new Set(named)].sort()).toEqual([...measures].sort());
      // No value of post_state: a migration that adds one cannot change what "in force" means.
      expect(view!.definition).not.toMatch(/post_state/);
      const columns = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string }>(sql`select attname::text as name from pg_attribute where attrelid = 'public.measures_in_force'::regclass and attnum > 0 order by attnum`);
      expect(columns.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["id", "kind", "post_id", "media_id", "subject_account_id", "decision_id", "decision_kind", "case_id"]);
    });
  });

  describe("each CHECK written from a contracts constant holds exactly that constant's values", () => {
    /** The quoted values of one CHECK, as the migrated database defines it. */
    const checkValues = async (table: string, name: string) => [...(await checkDefinition(table, name)).matchAll(/'([^']*)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]!).sort();
    /** The one number of a length CHECK. */
    async function checkBound(table: string, name: string): Promise<number> {
      const definition = await checkDefinition(table, name);
      const numbers = [...definition.matchAll(/<= (\d+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
      expect(numbers, definition).toHaveLength(1);
      return numbers[0]!;
    }

    test("the 16 Transparency Database categories, on intakes and on decisions", async () => {
      expect(await checkValues("intakes", "intakes_category")).toEqual([...TDB_CATEGORIES].sort());
      expect(await checkValues("decisions", "decisions_category")).toEqual([...TDB_CATEGORIES].sort());
    });

    test("the CSAM path's keywords on intakes, and a decision's keywords", async () => {
      const keywords = Object.values(CSAM_KEYWORDS).filter((keyword): keyword is NonNullable<typeof keyword> => keyword !== null);
      expect(await checkValues("intakes", "intakes_category_keyword")).toEqual([...keywords].sort());
      expect(await checkValues("decisions", "decisions_category_keyword")).toEqual([...DECISION_KEYWORDS].sort());
    });

    test("the six rules, on intakes and on decisions", async () => {
      expect(await checkValues("intakes", "intakes_rule_id")).toEqual([...RULE_IDS]);
      expect(await checkValues("decisions", "decisions_rule_id")).toEqual([...RULE_IDS]);
    });

    test("the bounds of a notice's two texts", async () => {
      expect(await checkBound("intakes", "intakes_explanation_len")).toBe(NOTICE_LIMITS.explanationMax);
      expect(await checkBound("intakes", "intakes_cited_law_len")).toBe(NOTICE_LIMITS.citedLawMax);
    });

    test("the ledger's kinds are the contracts' action kinds, in their order", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ label: string }>(sql`select e.enumlabel::text as label from pg_enum e where e.enumtypid = 'public.action_kind'::regtype order by e.enumsortorder`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.label)).toEqual([...ACTION_KINDS]);
    });

    test("post_state still has its four values: a seal is a state of images", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ label: string }>(sql`select e.enumlabel::text as label from pg_enum e where e.enumtypid = 'public.post_state'::regtype order by e.enumsortorder`);
      expect(rows.map((row) => row.label)).toEqual(["visible", "withheld", "removed", "deleted_by_author"]);
    });

    test("no check lets a row through on a null: the database holds the null-safe forms", async () => {
      // A CHECK passes when its expression is null. These five are written so that it never is. PostgreSQL stores
      // "is not distinct from" as the negation of "is distinct from" and prints it that way.
      expect(await checkDefinition("intake_items", "intake_items_case")).toContain("(NOT (outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_available'::item_outcome))");
      expect(await checkDefinition("decisions", "decisions_keyword")).toContain("(NOT (ground IS DISTINCT FROM 'illegal'::decision_ground))");
      expect(await checkDefinition("intake_items", "intake_items_statement")).toContain("statement_digest IS NOT NULL");
      expect(await checkDefinition("appeals", "appeals_statement")).toContain("statement_digest IS NOT NULL");
      expect(await checkDefinition("staff_texts", "staff_texts_digest")).toContain("salt ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'");
    });
  });

  describe("appeal_deadline", () => {
    test("it equals the contracts' appealDeadline on every month end of two years, a leap year among them, and on the days around them", async () => {
      // The last three days of each month of 2027 and 2028 (2028 has a 29 February) and the first of the next, at three times of day.
      // Both times as the text toISOString writes, so that nothing depends on how the driver reads a timestamp.
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ informed: string; deadline: string }>(sql`
        select to_char(t at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as informed, to_char(public.appeal_deadline(t) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as deadline
          from generate_series('2027-01-01'::timestamp, '2028-12-01'::timestamp, interval '1 month') month,
               generate_series(-3, 0) shift,
               unnest(array[interval '0 hours', interval '12 hours 30 minutes 15.25 seconds', interval '23 hours 59 minutes 59.999 seconds']) time_of_day,
               lateral (select (month + interval '1 month' + make_interval(days => shift) + time_of_day) at time zone 'UTC' as t) s
         order by 1`);
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(24 * 4 * 3);
      for (const row of rows) expect(appealDeadline(new Date(row.informed)).toISOString(), row.informed).toBe(row.deadline);
      // The set really holds the clamp: 31 August 2027 is due on the leap day.
      const august = rows.find((row) => row.informed === "2027-08-31T00:00:00.000Z");
      expect(august?.deadline).toBe("2028-02-29T00:00:00.000Z");
    });

    test("it does not depend on the session's time zone", async () => {
      const deadlines = await withLockTimeout(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const read = async () =>
          (await tx.execute<{ d: string }>(sql`select to_char(public.appeal_deadline('2027-08-30T23:30:00Z'::timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as d`))[0]!.d;
        // 30 August, 23:30 UTC, is already the 31st at +14 and still the 30th at -7: a deadline computed in the session's zone
        // would differ between the two, and from UTC's 29 February.
        await tx.execute(sql`set local time zone 'Pacific/Kiritimati'`);
        const east = await read();
        await tx.execute(sql`set local time zone 'America/Los_Angeles'`);
        return [east, await read()];
      });
      expect(deadlines).toEqual(["2028-02-29T23:30:00.000Z", "2028-02-29T23:30:00.000Z"]);
    });
  });

  describe("the forced columns ignore what an insert supplies", () => {
